# traecn-mcp
> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting external AI agents to TraeCN IDE on macOS via CDP.

TraeCN MCP enables external AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenClaw, Antigravity) to delegate coding tasks, inspect workspaces, and automate workflows in the TraeCN desktop IDE on macOS using 20 focused MCP tools.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/README.md): Overview, quickstart, web console, and daily check-in automation.
- [MCP Server Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/docs/MCP-SERVER-GUIDE.md): Setup, host configuration formats, tool details, and protocol compatibility.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/skills/traecn-mcp/SKILL.md): Agent-native skill specification and tool use guidance.
- [OpenClaw Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/docs/OPENCLAW-MCP-SETUP.md): Integration guide for OpenClaw and REST clients.
- [Runtime Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/docs/configuration.md): Environment variables, ports, and auto check-in options.
- [Deployment Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/docs/deployment.md): Background gateway service, LaunchAgent, and CLI operations.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated reference documentation including tool contracts and schemas.

## Optional
- [Compatibility Matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Supported TraeCN desktop versions and platform constraints.
- [Distribution Runbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/docs/DISTRIBUTION.md): Packaging, Homebrew tap, and npm bundles.
- [Smithery Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/main/smithery.yaml): Registry configuration for Smithery.ai CLI and 1-click installation.
